docs.summary: Canonical bundles of [`PostProcessFlags`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Importer.PostProcessFlags) for common scenarios.
No post-processing - the raw importer output.

Fast game-engine preset, prioritizing import speed. Includes [`LimitBoneWeights`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Importer.PostProcessFlags~LimitBoneWeights) because skipping it does not make a skinned import faster in any way that matters, it just hands the bake more influences than the four-slot vertex layout can carry.
Default preset for typical game loading: tangents, smooth normals, bone limit.
Editor preset, enabling validators, optimizers, and cache locality.
